# hpe_morpheus_catalog_item_type (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Catalog Item Type resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the catalog item type.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the catalog item type.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the catalog item type is enabled.
- `featured` (Boolean) Whether the catalog item type is featured.
- `type` (String) The type of catalog item (instance, blueprint, or workflow).
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the catalog item type (private or public).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the catalog item type.
